When inhaled, this effect lasts until the end of the character's next turn, when injected, the effect persists until the end of the encounter. Additionally, any character exposed to Minagen X3 must make an {@difficulty average|Resilience} for a single dose or a {@difficulty hard|Resilience} for two or more doses or suffer 2 wounds. If injected, the difficulty of this check is upgraded once.

gear.name: Neuroparalytic (1 dose)
description: A substance that paralyzes parts of a target's musculature without incapacitating them or affecting cognitive functions.

A character affected by the substance must make an {@difficulty average|Resilience} for a single dose, or a {@difficulty hard|Resilience} for two or more doses. If they fail the check, they are {@rule immobilized} for 3 rounds and can not take any actions that would require movement. Each {@symbols h} inflicts 1 strain on the target. The GM may spend {@symbols d} to have the target repeat this check on their next turn.

gear.name: Red Sand (1 dose)
description: Red sand is a stimulant with biotic-enhancing properties, originally created by criminal triads on Mars from refined element zero. It finds high use among non-biotic friends and relatives of biotics, often out of a misguided desire to understand what their loved ones are experiencing. The substance is sold in small bags of powder and its sale is considered legal on multiple worlds in the Terminus systems, as well as on Illium (provided the vendor has a permit). When taken nasally, the drug creates a brief but intense euphoria and grants the user short-term biotic abilities. However, its use comes with noticeable side effects such as red-tinted vision and discolored teeth and it is addictive even in small doses.

A character taking a dose of Red Sand who has no ranks in {@skill Biotics} counts as having 1 rank in {@skill Biotics}. They may use biotic abilities even if they were normally unable to, but they may not add any modifiers to the powers they use. A character who already possesses biotic abilities adds {@dice setback} to all {@skill Biotics} checks for each dose taken. Asari and batarians are immune to red sand.

gear.name: Red Sand (20 dose crate)
description: Red sand is a stimulant with biotic-enhancing properties, originally created by criminal triads on Mars from refined element zero. It finds high use among non-biotic friends and relatives of biotics, often out of a misguided desire to understand what their loved ones are experiencing. The substance is sold in small bags of powder and its sale is considered legal on multiple worlds in the Terminus systems, as well as on Illium (provided the vendor has a permit). When taken nasally, the drug creates a brief but intense euphoria and grants the user short-term biotic abilities. However, its use comes with noticeable side effects such as red-tinted vision and discolored teeth and it is addictive even in small doses.

A character taking a dose of Red Sand who has no ranks in {@skill Biotics} counts as having 1 rank in {@skill Biotics}. They may use biotic abilities even if they were normally unable to, but they may not add any modifiers to the powers they use. A character who already possesses biotic abilities adds {@dice setback} to all {@skill Biotics} checks for each dose taken. Asari and batarians are immune to red sand.

gear.name: Synthetic Neurotoxin (1 dose)
description: A strong poison that affects the biochemical reactions of most creatures, sometimes fatally. The substance can be introduced into the body as an aerosol, via ingestion or through injection.

A character affected by the toxin must make an {@difficulty average|Resilience} for a single dose, or a {@difficulty hard|Resilience} for two or more doses. If they fail the check, they suffer 5 wounds. Each {@symbols h} inflicts 1 strain on the target. The GM may spend {@symbols d} to have the target repeat this check on their next turn.

gear.name: Videlicit (1 dose)
description: A complex chemical stimulant that improves short-term memory and mental focus. It is a favorite among people having to work in investigation, negotiation or other businesses that benefit from quick wits and heightened senses. The substance is legal but traditionally regulated through prescriptions. Long-term use may prove addictive.
A dose of Videlicit lasts for one encounter and allows the user to add {@dice boost} to all {@characteristic Cunning} and {@characteristic Presence} based checks until the end of the encounter.

gear.name: Bioscan
description: A healer must be able to recognize any anomalies in a patient's biological makeup in order to properly cure an injury. A bioscan is capable of identifying an individual's species, age and condition based on a pre-programmed set of parameters. It can also recognize disruptions to the anatomy from injuries or diseases as well as deliberate modifications such as cybernetics.
A character using a bioscan removes up to {@dice setback|2} from any {@skill Medicine} check they make.

gear.name: Doctor's Bag
description: This sizable bag contains all the supplies one would find in a small clinic, but compressed to fit into a single backpack. It contains all tools necessary for extensive medical treatment, from tools, over bandages and drugs to a small computer system to aid in diagnostics. The only downside is the high cost.

A doctor's bag allows a character to heal wounds or {@rule Critical Injuries} without penalty. In addition, whenever the character successfully makes a check to heal wounds, their target heals 1 additional wound and 1 additional strain.

gear.name: Emergency Medkit
description: Emergency medkits are small, comprehensive supply kits used to treat moderate injuries in emergency situations. Among their contents are bandages, some basic drugs, antiseptics, sterile tools, blood coagulants, and other basic supplies. However, due to their small size, their quantity is limited.

An emergency medkit allows a character to heal wounds or {@rule Critical Injuries} without penalty. If the character's {@skill Medicine} check generates {@symbols hhh} or {@symbols d}, it means that they have used up all of the kit's supplies, and the medkit may no longer be used.

gear.name: Medi-gel
description: An all-purpose medicinal salve which combines anesthetics and numbing agents with clotting agents in order to quickly dress wounds. The gel seals the wounds against liquids, gasses and contaminants and encourages a rapid healing process.

Medi-gel is a {@gear painkiller}, described on page 94 of the {@title Genesys} Core Rulebook, with a setting-specific name. Any rules, talents and abilities governing and affecting {@rule painkillers} apply to medi-gel as well.

gear.name: Numbcaine
description: A staple of field treatment, used to allow soldiers to fight on despite injuries. While it does little to treat the injury, it addresses many of the symptoms for a short time and deadens any pain with only minor numbness.

A character may apply numbcaine to themselves or an engaged character with a maneuver. When they do, they select one {@rule Critical Injuries|Critical Injury} and ignore any penalties it imposes on skill checks they make (at your GM's discretion, this may not apply to the penalties from certain {@rule Critical Injuries}, such as blindness or loss of a limb). At the end of the encounter, the character no longer ignores those penalties and immediately suffers 4 strain.

gear.name: Spray-On Cast
description: Quickly immobilizing a limb injury after it happens can prevent the extremity from becoming more seriously damaged through accidental misuse. Prompt action reduces the patient's overall healing time, even though further treatment may be required. A spray-on cast is an easily portable tool that can be used in field conditions, to reinforce a wounded limb from the outside, preventing it from bending and exacerbating tissue damage.

A character can make an {@difficulty easy|Medicine} to apply a spray-on cast to a limb that has been crippled or disabled due to a {@rule Critical Injuries|Critical Injury}. If successful, the {@rule Critical Injuries|Critical Injury} heals automatically after one week of narrative time.

gear.name: Forensic Kit
description: Used primarily by {@rule C-Sec} Investigators in the field, a forensic kit contains a limited set of items and tools to investigate a scene. The kit is about the size of a large suitcase and features storage boxes of evidence, tools for fingerprint recovery and DNA sample collection, analyzers, a camera drone, and the tools to create a holographic snapshot of a scene to look at later.

In addition to the recording, analyzing and evidence-gathering uses, a character using the kit adds {@symbols s} to {@skill Vigilance} and {@skill Perception} checks made while searching a scene using a forensic kit. At the GM's discretion, a kit similar to this could also be used for archaeological digs, with its specialized equipment being adjusted to match.

gear.name: Handcuffs
description: A set of reinforced composite binders, further strengthened by mass effect fields. These are commonly carried by security personnel such as {@rule C-Sec} officers.
Escaping handcuffs without heavy cutting tools requires a {@difficulty formidable|Athletics} or {@difficulty daunting|Coordination}.

gear.name: Infiltrator Goggles
description: A set of bulky goggles using multi-spectrum cameras, thermal imaging and micro radar systems to project adjusted images onto the internal screens.

While wearing these goggles, a character removes {@dice setback|2} added to their checks due to darkness, smoke, or other forms of {@rule Concealment (Darkness, Smoke, and Intervening Terrain)|concealment}.

gear.name: Lockpick Set
description: A small collection of probes, picks, tension spanners, and other tools used to open mechanical locks. There are some commercially available sets, sold typically to hobbyists and locksmiths, however professional infiltrators and lock breakers may prefer more personalized sets with additional more niche tools.

A lockpick set counts as a tool kit for the purposes of opening mechanical and simple electrical locks. In addition, when a character makes a {@skill Skulduggery} check to open a lock with the kit, they add {@symbols a} to the results.

gear.name: Surveillance Scanner
description: Surveillance scanners are handheld devices used to detect active and passive surveillance systems. Typically used to check rooms for bugs or search for hidden observers or electronic surveillance, these scanners can detect and locate comms signals, electromagnetic fields, power fluctuations, and more, depending on the model.

Surveillance scanners have a range of up to long, and using them upgrades the ability of any checks made to locate bugs, sweep rooms for hidden cameras, pick up data streams, or engage in any other counter-surveillance activities once.

gear.name: Breath Mask and Respirator
description: A mask featuring an attached filter and oxygen recirculator which allows breathing in hostile atmospheres for up to an hour. The mask is adjustable to fit most species, but only covers nose and mouth and does not provide protection from hard {@rule vacuum}.

gear.name: Hazardous Environment Gear
description: A fully enclosed, positive-pressure suit designed to allow operation in environments that are not just dangerous to breathe, but harmful in other ways, such as acidic rains, hard {@rule vacuum}, or caustic gasses.

The suit can not be worn over armor and a character wearing it adds {@dice setback} to any {@characteristic Agility}-based checks, as well as all {@skill Perception} and {@skill Vigilance} checks they make. It provides breathable atmosphere for up to 8 hours, though exhausting work may result in faster consumption.

gear.name: Camouflage Netting
description: This sophisticated and versatile camouflage is often used by military and paramilitary organizations to conceal encampments, supply caches, vehicles and other high-value assets. Made from photo-reactive fibers that mimic their surroundings, it is a cheap and quick solution for disguising presence.

The netting upgrades the difficulty of all {@skill Perception} checks to detect items hidden by it once. One roll of netting can conceal an object of up to silhouette 2, two rolls can conceal an object of up to silhouette 3. An object of silhouette 4 or larger is too large to be concealed.

gear.name: Portable Power Generator
description: Out in the field, power is just as important as food, water, medical supplies and ammunition. As such, many independently working teams, or adventuring parties choose to bring along a generator to supply them with power for the various other pieces of equipment they carry.

A portable power generator can supply energy to various pieces of equipment and even larger pieces of machinery. Limitations for the size of machinery or compatibility are left to the GM's discretion.

gear.name: Survival Kit
description: Also referred to as "Crash Kit", these bags contain everything a single person needs to sustain themselves in a wilderness environment for up to a week. Stocking rations, water filters, flares, a utility knife, distress beacon, thermal cloak and a small sleeping cocoon, ships and their escape pods are outfitted with these to allow crew-members to stay alive until rescue arrives.

gear.name: Console Server
description: These large, bulky, computer terminals are commonly employed in most businesses, research installations, embassies and really any other organization that requires larger digital setups. While not portable at all, they offer high processing power and storage space, as well as the ability to be combined in clusters to create large, powerful server farms.

A console server may be used as a work space for crafting software (see page 76), and its high processing power and subroutine support adds {@dice boost} to any crafting checks made with it. When multiple console servers are linked together, instead of adding {@dice boost}, upgrade the crafting check once per server, up to three times.

gear.name: Cultural Etiquette Manual
description: Many diplomats, envoys, emissaries or other regular travelers are frequently required to interact with the variety of other sentient species in the galaxy. In order to not embarrass themselves when approaching them, many prefer to read these detailed summaries of cultural behavior, speech and body language beforehand.

A character with a cultural etiquette manual adds automatic {@symbols a} to social checks made to interact with members of the culture or species to which the manual pertains as well as to any {@skill Knowledge (Society)} checks concerning them.

gear.name: Datapad
description: Datapads are multi-use display devices used to record, store, display, and organize data. They are used in situations where their convenience of being passed around and held in hand outweighs the limits of an omni-tool, such as briefings, cargo logs, attendance lists, manifests, or research notes.

gear.name: Gel Repair Patch
description: Repair patches are adhesive patches of alloy composite loaded with omni-gel, which are frequently used to patch up minor damages to machinery, fix leaky pipes or even seal a breach on an envirosuit.

A character may spend a maneuver and expend a gel repair patch to repair 1 hull trauma on a vehicle or to heal the chassis of an AI character (see page 20) in the same way that {@gear medi-gel} heals an organic character.
Additionally, any character who has suffered a breach to their suit while in hostile conditions (including quarians and volus) may spend a maneuver and expend a patch to seal this leak.

gear.name: Fabricator
description: An evolution of the 3D printers that began their rise to popularity at the start of the 21st century, these small, automated fabrication suites can create objects from industrial plastics, ceramics and light alloys. They can not assemble full complex objects like firearms or computer systems, but can produce all the components to assemble them with.

A fabricator can create a simple tool (or equivalent part) with an encumbrance value of 2 or less. The process takes a while depending on the object created, but does not need to be supervised, and requires an amount of raw materials (usually in the form of omni-gel).

gear.name: Mercantile Datapad
description: This very useful datapad is loaded with detailed business, law and mercantile information about a certain region of the galaxy and can provide useful insights on the price and availability of products, as well as their relations to the galactic economy and stock markets.

When your character acquires a mercantile datapad, they choose one region of the galaxy - Attican Traverse, batarian space, council space, {@rule Systems Alliance}, or Terminus Systems - for the datapad to be programmed for. They add {@dice boost} to any {@skill Negotiation} checks made to sell or buy goods in that region.

gear.name: Personal Terminal
description: A small computer with a holographic projection screen and interface. While they don't offer the tremendous processing power of a {@gear Console Server}, Terminals still outclass an omni-tool and offer a more user-friendly, long-term interface.
A terminal serves as a work space for crafting software (see page 76).

gear.name: Portable Toolkit
description: In a galaxy dependent on technology, a well stocked toolkit is essential. They are produced by various manufacturers and contain everything needed to maintain gear, vehicles, mechs and weaponry. Most standard kits come with a selection of tools like wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, but also feature voltmeters, probes, and small arc-cutters and welders.
A portable toolkit provides a character with the equipment needed to make a {@skill Mechanics} check without penalty.

gear.name: Auto Injector
description: Commonly in use by solo-operatives, this unobtrusive gadget is a small medical monitoring system and injection pump which can help someone stay on their feet during dangerous encounters.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor.

{@b Modifiers:} This attachment can be loaded with one dose of {@gear medi-gel} or a drug of the user's choice. As an incidental, the wearer can activate this attachment and apply the loaded item to themselves.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Camouflage Paint
description: The use of environmentally matching colors and patterns, applied to the armor, makes the wearer a lot harder to see in matching terrain.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor.

{@b Modifiers:} When acquiring this attachment, choose an environment it is camouflaged for. While in that environment, add {@dice setback} to any {@skill Perception} or {@skill Vigilance} checks to detect the wearer and add {@dice boost} to any {@skill Stealth} checks the wearer makes to stay hidden.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Environmental Protection
description: Additional radiation shielding, thermal padding, heating or water reclamation systems greatly improve the wearer's survivability in unfavorable environments.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor.

{@b Modifiers:} When acquiring this attachment, choose one adverse environmental condition (such as extreme cold, extreme heat, radiation, corrosive atmosphere, ...). Reduce the difficulty of {@skill Resilience} checks to resist the effects of that environment by one. Remove up to {@dice setback|2} imposed by that condition.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Enhanced Optics
description: Combining various optical enhancements such as passive night vision, thermal and ultrasound imaging, polarized filters and micro radar, this sensor-suit provides the user with exceptional visual improvements.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor that includes a helmet.
{@b Modifiers:} Remove {@dice setback|2} added to the wearer's checks due to smoke or darkness.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Improved Kinetic Barriers
description: Strengthened shield generators and with better field distribution and recharge rates improve the defensive abilities of a combat hardsuit.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor which provides at least 1 ranged defense.
{@b Modifiers:} The armor increases its ranged defense by 1.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Integrated Compartments
description: A hidden compartment within the armor's framework which allows storage of a tool or weapon. This ensures the wearer is never caught off guard.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor and can be applied multiple times.

{@b Modifiers:} May holster a tool or weapon of encumbrance 3 or lower in the armor. While holstered, that item does not count toward the character's {@rule Encumbrance Values|encumbrance value}. Add {@dice setback} to any checks made to find the item. The armor also increases its encumbrance by 2.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Jump Jets
description: Originally designed as maneuvering jets for EVA operations, stronger powered jump jets were also found to allow brief flight within atmospheres.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor with a rigid carapace.

{@b Modifiers:} While wearing the armor, once per encounter the character may activate the jump jets as an out-of-turn incidental. Until the end of their next turn, they may fly and do not suffer damage from {@rule falling}.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Kinetic Exoskeleton
description: This exosuit frame, using mass effect fields in conjunction with hydraulics and actuators, allows the user to lift and carry more mass and for longer periods of time.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor with a rigid carapace.

{@b Modifiers:} When wearing this armor, a character increases their {@rule encumbrance threshold} by 5 and adds {@symbols s} to any {@characteristic Brawn}-based checks they make (with the exception of {@skill Resilience}).
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Lightweight Materials
description: Making use of advanced polymers and slimmer construction reduces the weight and bulk of the armor.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor.
{@b Modifiers:} The armor reduces its encumbrance by 2, and it adds one fewer {@dice setback} to {@skill Coordination} and {@skill Stealth} checks.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Reinforced Plating
description: In direct opposition to the choice of {@gear lightweight materials}, heavily reinforced armor can provide exceptional defense even against penetrating ammunition.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor.
{@b Modifiers:} The armor gains the {@quality Reinforced} quality and increases its encumbrance by 1.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Sealed Environment
description: When outfitting species who rely on unique environments to survive (such as quarian or volus) a heavier set of armor needs to afford them the same capabilities as the protective suits they traditionally wear.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor that covers the entire body and includes a helmet.

{@b Modifiers:} The armor provides the wearer with the same protection as a {@gear Sealed Environmental Suit|Sealed Environment Suit} (see page 57) and is exclusively designed for a specific species in the same way.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Vacuum Sealed
description: By changing out the underlying meshsuit and installing joint seals and special coatings, a full body armored suit can be made impervious to almost any hostile environment. A vacuum-sealed suit protects the wearer from nuclear, biological, and chemical agents; extreme heat or cold and the {@rule vacuum} of space.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor that covers the entire body and includes a helmet.
{@b Modifiers:} While wearing this armor, a character may ignore the effects of {@rule vacuum} and other hazardous environments for up to two hours.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Weapon Mount
description: A feature common among elcor, but also adapted by heavy combat units of the {@rule Systems Alliance|Alliance} or turians, weapon mounts on armor allow attaching a firearm directly to the hardsuit, functioning as a secondary weapon system or in the case of the elcor, a way to fight with their hands free.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any armor with a rigid carapace.

{@b Modifiers:} Allows the character to mount a single ranged weapon with an encumbrance of up to their {@characteristic Brawn} + 1 to the armor. They may aim and fire this weapon without using their hands.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Advanced IFF System
description: Making use of a VI linked directly to the targeting and trigger system, this system greatly reduces the likelihood of friendly fire. The weapon takes a moment to scan its surroundings and identify participants in the combat, but once done so, it refuses to allow the weapon to fire when the shot could hit a friendly.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} A character may spend a maneuver during an encounter to activate the target-selection system. If they do, for the remainder of the encounter, the GM cannot spend {@symbols d} from their combat checks to cause the attack to hit an ally engaged with their original target.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Balanced Hilt
description: An example of excellent craftsmanship, weapons that have been perfectly balanced allow their wielders to strike their targets with greater ease.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any one-handed {@skill Melee} weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} The weapon gains the {@quality Accurate|Accurate 1} item quality or increases its existing {@quality Accurate} rating by 1. (If the weapon has the {@quality Inaccurate} item quality, it reduces that quality's rating by 1, to a minimum of 0, instead.)
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Bipod Mount
description: Bipods are simple, two-legged stands used to stabilize weapons and make them easier to operate. While often considered outdated technology, their simplicity still makes them quite popular.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any {@skill Ranged (Heavy)} or {@skill Gunnery} weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} As a maneuver, a character can deploy the bipod, reducing the weapon's {@quality Cumbersome} or {@quality Unwieldy} quality by 2, to a minimum of 0, and reducing the weapon's encumbrance by 2, to a minimum of 0, while the character fires from a {@rule prone} position (or can brace the bipod against something solid).
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Burst Fire Receiver
description: By adjusting the weapon's field cycle speed, it can be adjusted to fire multiple shots in quick succession.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that fires projectiles.

{@b Modifiers:} The weapon gains the {@quality Linked|Linked 2} item quality and reduces its damage by 2. If the weapon has the {@quality Auto-fire} quality, do not reduce its damage due to this attachment and remove the {@quality Auto-fire} quality.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 0 if the weapon has the {@quality Auto-fire} quality, otherwise 1.

gear.name: Charge Capacitors
description: Adding an optional capacitor charge loop allows powering up the weapon before shooting, greatly increasing its damage potential at the cost of excess heat generation.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that could benefit from charging up.

{@b Modifiers:} A character may spend a maneuver to charge the weapon, up to a maximum of 3 charges. For each charge, increase the damage of the next combat check made with that weapon by 2 and add {@symbols h} to the result of the check. The GM may spend {@symbols hhh} or {@symbols d} from that check to cause the weapon to run out of ammo. Unused charges are lost at the end of an encounter.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Close Combat Bayonet
description: Recent encounters with the creatures known as husks have shown that a ranged weapon is easily disadvantaged by foes that can close the distance to the user. This attachment serves as a backup for those situations.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that could logically benefit from an attached melee weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} When installed, the user chooses one of the following melee weapons. They can then use this secondary profile with their weapon. The weapon also increases its encumbrance by 1. {@b Bayonet:} ({@skill Melee}; Damage +1; Critical 3; Range [Engaged]; {@quality Pierce|Pierce 2}).
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Close Combat Omni-blade
description: Recent encounters with the creatures known as husks have shown that a ranged weapon is easily disadvantaged by foes that can close the distance to the user. This attachment serves as a backup for those situations.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that could logically benefit from an attached melee weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} When installed, the user chooses one of the following melee weapons. They can then use this secondary profile with their weapon. The weapon also increases its encumbrance by 1. {@b Omni-blade:} ({@skill Melee}; Damage +1; Critical 2; Range [Engaged]; {@quality Pierce|Pierce 1}, {@quality Vicious|Vicious 1}).
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Close Combat Melee Stunner
description: Recent encounters with the creatures known as husks have shown that a ranged weapon is easily disadvantaged by foes that can close the distance to the user. This attachment serves as a backup for those situations.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that could logically benefit from an attached melee weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} When installed, the user chooses one of the following melee weapons. They can then use this secondary profile with their weapon. The weapon also increases its encumbrance by 1. {@b Stunner:} ({@skill Melee}; Damage +1; Critical 5; Range [Engaged]; {@quality Disorient|Disorient 1}, {@quality Stun|Stun 3}, {@quality Stun Damage}).
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Enhanced Weight
description: While the trend goes towards light and portable weaponry, there is still some benefit to some heft, namely the greatly increased energy on impact.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any {@skill Brawl} or {@skill Melee} weapon that deals bludgeoning or crushing damage (not one with a cutting edge).
{@b Modifiers:} The weapon increases its damage by 2. The weapon gains the {@quality Cumbersome|Cumbersome 3} quality, or increases its existing {@quality Cumbersome} quality by 1.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Extended Barrel
description: This attachment extends the barrel of the weapon, allowing it to fire its projectiles longer distances.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} The weapon's range increases by one range band, to a maximum of extreme range. The weapon gains the {@quality Cumbersome|Cumbersome 2} quality or increases its existing {@quality Cumbersome} quality by 2.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Flechette Shaver
description: Using a modified mass effect field generator, this weapon creates flechette projectiles that fragment shortly after leaving the weapon. While this shortens the weapon's range, it allows it to hit targets in a wide spread.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that fires projectiles and does not already possess the {@quality Blast} quality.

{@b Modifiers:} The weapon gains the {@quality Blast} item quality with a rating equal to half the weapon's damage, rounded up. The weapon's range is reduced by one range band, to a minimum of engaged.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: ID Lock
description: Using fingerprint, or similar biometric technologies, weapons with an ID lock can only be used by the owner for whom they have been programmed.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} This weapon cannot be fired except by its designated user. Unlocking and reprogramming a stolen or otherwise "acquired" weapon requires a {@difficulty daunting|Computers}. Your GM may spend {@symbols hhh} or {@symbols d} from this check to permanently disable the locked weapon, rendering it useless.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Improved Kinetic Coils
description: Using additional capacitors to allow high energy bursts to the mass effect field generators, this attachment increases the weapon's kinetic output and penetration.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that fires projectiles.
{@b Modifiers:} The weapon gains the {@quality Pierce|Pierce 1} item quality, or increases its existing {@quality Pierce} rating by 1.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Outdated Heatsink
description: This weapon makes use of the old heat vent system in use before the majority of the galaxy adopted thermal clips in 2185.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that normally uses thermal clips and does not have the {@quality Limited Ammo} quality.

{@b Modifiers:} When this weapon runs out of ammo, it instead overheats and must vent this heat. It may not be used the following round, but is usable again afterwards. Your GM may spend {@symbols hhh} or {@symbols d} to have this weapon run out of ammo.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Paired Weapons
description: Some elite operatives like to wield a pistol in each hand, and some flashy mercenaries even prefer to pair a blade with a pistol. This weapon modification balances a pair of weapons, allowing the wielder to use them in perfect tandem.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can only be applied to two one-handed weapons at the same time.
{@b Modifiers:} When making a {@rule two-weapon combat|two-weapon combat check}, reduce the {@symbols a} required to hit with the secondary weapon by 1.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1 (per weapon).

gear.name: Quick-release Holster
description: Outfitted with an instant release clip and motion-assisting systems, along with increased readying speed on the weapon's internal servos, these special holsters allow for blindingly fast speeds when readying weapons.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any {@skill Ranged (Light)} weapon.
{@b Modifiers:} This weapon can be drawn as an incidental rather than as a maneuver.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Recoil Compensators
description: Making use of the internal mass effect field generators to briefly adjust the weapon's mass and reduce its kick upon discharge.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that fires projectiles.
{@b Modifiers:} The weapon reduces its {@quality Inaccurate} item quality by 1, to a minimum of 0.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Superior Customization
description: This attachment tweaks a weapon to an individual's specifications, making it an extension of the user rather than a run-of-the-mill weapon.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any weapon.
{@b Modifiers:} This weapon gains the {@quality Superior} item quality.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Suppressor
description: A combination of sound moderator and muzzle flash hider, suppressors are used to reduce the attention a firearm attracts when discharged. Suppressed weapons are often favored by assassins, sharpshooters and intelligence agents.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon that fires projectiles.
{@b Modifiers:} Add {@dice setback|2} to any {@skill Perception} or {@skill Vigilance} checks made to locate a character firing this weapon.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Tactical Visor
description: Upgrading and linking the weapon's internal targeting system to the user's helmet (or a separately worn visor) allows direct feedback for optimal aim.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any ranged weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} The weapon gains the {@quality Accurate|Accurate 1} item quality or increases its existing {@quality Accurate} rating by 1. (If the weapon has the {@quality Inaccurate} item quality, it reduces that quality's rating by 1, to a minimum of 0, instead.) This bonus cannot be combined with any other bonus from a different scope or sight.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Telescopic Sight
description: A high-magnification scope with multiple levels of zoom and an integrated rangefinder, greatly aiding shots made at longer ranges.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any {@skill Ranged (Heavy)} weapon.
{@b Modifiers:} Reduce the difficulty of ranged combat checks made with this weapon at long and extreme range by 1. This bonus cannot be combined with any other bonus from a different scope or sight.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Thermal Scope
description: This scope makes use of IR sensors to allow the user to identify targets by body heat, even in dark or obscured conditions.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any {@skill Ranged (Heavy)} weapon.

{@b Modifiers:} Allows the user to observe and target enemies who are hidden by solid objects (provided the object is not too thick). Removes up to {@dice setback|2} imposed by darkness or {@rule Concealment (Darkness, Smoke, and Intervening Terrain)|concealment} from ranged combat checks. This bonus cannot be combined with any other bonus from a different scope or sight. The weapon increases its encumbrance by 2.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Ultralight Materials
description: Replacing pieces of the weapon's frame with low-weight ceramics and nano-polymers greatly reduces its weight.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any weapon.
{@b Modifiers:} The weapon decreases its encumbrance by 1 (to a minimum of 1).
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: VI Fire Assist
description: The accompanying system to the elcor's infamous armor mounted weaponry, these logical systems make use of compiled tactical patterns to evaluate the combat situation and provide the optimal targeting solution.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can only be applied to weapons mounted on the {@gear Weapon Mount} armor attachment.

{@b Modifiers:} When making an attack with the mounted weapon, the VI performs the {@rule Assist} maneuver, adding {@dice boost} to the check. If the weapon was not used this round, the user may spend {@symbols aaa} or {@symbols t} from any skill check they make to cause the VI to attack a target within the weapon's range. The attack succeeds automatically with one {@symbols s} and no {@symbols a} or {@symbols h}. After that, the weapon can not be used until the start of the character's next turn.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Advanced Sensor Suite
description: Upgrading the vehicle's existing sensors and outfitting it with VI evaluation systems assists operators in tactical, terrain or lifeform scans (depending on the variation of the suite).

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any vehicle.

{@b Modifiers:} When acquiring this attachment, choose one variation of the suite, Terrain, Lifeforms or Tactics. While making use of the sensors, add {@dice boost|2} to all {@skill Knowledge (PhysSci)}, {@skill Knowledge (LifeSci)} or {@skill Knowledge (Warfare)} checks respectively. This attachment can be purchased multiple times to add the other suites.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1 (for the initial sensors), 0 (for additional variations of the suite).

gear.name: Amphibious Modification
description: Outfitting the vehicle with atmospheric seals and pressure reinforcement, as well as electrolyzing intake systems and thrust shrouds allows it to operate underwater. While still not as adapted like a designated submarine vehicle, it is a common modification for survey ships and hanar vessels of the Illuminated Primacy.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any vehicle of silhouette 5 or lower.
{@b Modifiers:} The vehicle can land on water and operate underwater without penalty.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Autopilot VI
description: A simple VI system designed to perform basic maneuvers with the vehicle, though it is no replacement for a skilled pilot.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any vehicle.

{@b Modifiers:} The VI can perform {@skill Driving}, {@skill Operating} or {@skill Piloting} checks with a skill rank of 2 and 0 in their respective characteristic (in effect this means it rolls {@dice ability|2} for these checks); may be summoned to the owner's position.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 0.

gear.name: Biosphere Habitation Module
description: While the majority of species can survive in shared environments, some are relegated to tools that allow them to adapt or risk consequences. The quarian and volus are confined to environmental suits, hanar rely on levitation devices, and drell see their health threatened by high humidity. To account for this, their own ships are often equipped with rooms that can provide them with their preferred biosphere - in some cases the entire ship is kept in such a state.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any starship.

{@b Modifiers:} When acquiring this attachment, choose a specific environment which it replicates (such as the high pressure ammonia atmosphere of Irune, or the sterile environments of quarian clean rooms). Any room modified by this attachment can be adjusted to provide this environment, allowing characters of a matching species to not rely on {@gear sealed environmental suit|sealed environmental suits}.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1 per modified room, or 0 if the entire ship has its biosphere modified.

gear.name: Decoy Buoy
description: Popular among smugglers, pirates and other characters on the run from law enforcement, these devices are often custom built from scrap pieces. Broadcasting a fake transponder signal and using a small internal fusion generator to mimic thruster output and project heat signatures, they are used to create a fake target for pursuers and throw them off course, though the charade falters at any visual inspection.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any starship.

{@b Modifiers:} A decoy buoy can be jettisoned as an action. It appears as a ship to the sensors of any surrounding vessels and can optionally broadcast a distress signal. Determining a buoy as fake requires a {@difficulty hard|computers} or getting into visual range (short range) with the buoy.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 0.

gear.name: Encrypted Comms Array
description: These custom arrays are tuned to heavily encrypted channels on the extranet grid, allowing effortless access and near perfect communication safety within these channels. Due to each being custom made and using complex technology and violating extranet laws, these suites are only used by intelligence agencies, information brokers and advanced para-military forces.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any vehicle.

{@b Modifiers:} Grants access to the unique network it was tuned to, such as broker channels, intelligence servers or pirate networks. Adds {@dice boost|2} to all {@skill Knowledge (Underground)} checks made in these networks. Any attempt to intercept and decrypt these messages requires a {@difficulty formidable|computers}.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 0.

gear.name: GARDIAN Lasers
description: The {@b G}eneral {@b A}rea {@b D}efense {@b I}ntegration {@b A}nti-spacecraft {@b N}etwork is a shipboard system installed on all major capital ships. An array of laser turrets designed to intercept enemy missiles and {@vehicle fighter|fighters}, controlled mostly by automated computer systems (though it requires an operator to identify and designate threats). The Salarian Union and geth vehicles make use of UV lasers instead of infrared spectrum, increasing their range at the cost of reliability.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any starship of silhouette 4 or larger.
{@b Modifiers:} The GARDIAN system conveys two benefits:

An operator may perform the "{@rule Intercept Projectiles}" vehicle action (see page 229 of the {@title Genesys} Core Rulebook) with the GARDIAN system by making a {@difficulty hard|computers}. If successful, instead of the normal effect, upgrade the difficulty of all incoming attacks made with rockets, missiles or torpedoes once per uncancelled {@symbols s}.

The GARDIAN system may also be used as a vehicle weapon with the following profile ({@skill Computers}; Fire Arc All; Damage 6; Critical 6; Range [Engaged]; {@quality Accurate|Accurate 1}, {@quality Phasic|Phasic 4}).

The salarian and geth GARDIAN systems can be used up to short range but also add {@symbols h} to any check made with the system. If any check using the GARDIAN system generates {@symbols hhh} or {@symbols d}, the system overheats and may not be used for 2 rounds.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Helios Thruster Modules
description: An advanced concept for maneuvering thrusters, the Helios modules make use of a metastable, metallic hydrogen for fuel instead of the common H2/O2 fuel tanks. The system greatly increases fuel efficiency and provides the pilot with faster and more precise maneuvering capabilities.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any starship.
{@b Modifiers:} Increase the vehicle's {@rule handling} by 1.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Internal Emission System
description: Long thought impossible, "stealth" technology in starships was finally achieved as part of a human and turian joint initiative. This system negates a vehicle's thermal output by storing all excess thermal energy in heatsinks spread throughout the hull to be released later, rendering it invisible to the scanning systems of other vessels. The system has an operational time limit, as the heatsinks would eventually cook the ship's insides and crew.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any starship.

{@b Modifiers:} Allows the ship to enter 'silent running' rendering it invisible to enemy sensors, though it remains detectable by visual inspection at short range. After about 3 hours, the system must be shut off to vent excess thermal energy, otherwise the vehicle suffers 2 system strain at the start of every round and all crew and passengers suffer 2 wounds at the start of their turn. Venting the excess thermal energy takes the same time the vehicle spent in silent running.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1.

gear.name: Internal Hangar Bay
description: Many vehicles that feature larger cargo bays can be converted to possess an internal hangar by adding atmospheric rayshielding and docking systems.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any vehicle of silhouette 4 or larger.

{@b Modifiers:} Allows the vessel to store and deploy smaller vehicles (with a silhouette of 2 smaller than the carrier vehicle) from its cargo bay. The maximum combined total silhouette of all stored vehicles is dependent on the carrier's silhouette:
{@b Silhouette 4:} Can store a combined silhouette of 2.
{@b Silhouette 5:} can store a combined silhouette of 5.
{@b Silhouette 6:} can store a combined silhouette of 20.
{@b Silhouette 7:} can store a combined silhouette of 60.
For each point of silhouette stored, decrease the carrier vehicle's encumbrance capacity by 20.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Structural Reinforcement: Cyclonic Barriers
description: This encompasses a variety of upgrades that can be made to the vehicle's structure, improving its survivability. Each of these attachments can only be added once.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any vehicle that can logically benefit from the individual attachment.
{@b Modifiers:} When acquired, choose one of the following.
{@b Cyclonic Barriers:} Increase the vehicle's defense by 1.
{@b Hardened Superstructure:} Increase the vehicle's {@rule hull trauma threshold} by 3.
{@b Redundant Circuitry:} Increase the vehicle's {@rule system strain threshold} by 3.
{@b Silaris Armor:} Increase the vehicle's armor by 1.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

description: This encompasses a variety of upgrades that can be made to the vehicle's structure, improving its survivability. Each of these attachments can only be added once.

{@b Redundant Circuitry:} Increase the vehicle's {@rule system strain threshold} by 3.
{@b Silaris Armor:} Increase the vehicle's armor by 1.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 2.

gear.name: Targeting Assistance VI
description: This VI system is designed to assist vehicle gunners with target acquisition, lead and ballistic mechanics. While some criticize it for interfering with a gunner's natural ability, most are quite content with the assistance the system provides.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any vehicle that is equipped with weapons.
{@b Modifiers:} Upgrade the ability of all {@skill Gunnery} checks made to fire the vehicle's weapons by one.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 0.

gear.name: Upgraded Weapons
description: This is the simple act of improving a vehicle's combat capabilities by adding or replacing weapon systems. The weapons that can be added are dependent on the silhouette and type of the vehicle. Further information on vehicle weapons can be found in the following section.

items: {@b Use With:} This attachment can be applied to any vehicle.

{@b Modifiers:} Choose one weapon from {@b Table 4-2: Vehicle Weapons} to be added to the vehicle, or to replace an existing weapon. Traditionally, weapons added this way are mounted on turrets, allowing them to cover all firing arcs. Weapons can also be added as twinned or quad systems, gaining the {@quality Linked|Linked 1} or {@quality Linked|Linked 3} quality respectively at double or quadruple the cost. All vehicle weapons are fired with the {@skill Gunnery} skill.
{@b Hard Points Required:} 1 (when adding a weapon), 0 (if replacing an existing weapon system).

gear.name: Accelerator Cannon
description: Using mass effect fields to accelerate metal slugs to incredibly high velocities, imbuing them with energy to rival that of a nuclear warhead. These cannons come in normal or heavy variants, the latter using stronger coils but requiring more power.
When mounted on planetary vehicles, the range of these weapons changes to extreme.

gear.name: Accelerator Cannon (Heavy)
description: Using mass effect fields to accelerate metal slugs to incredibly high velocities, imbuing them with energy to rival that of a nuclear warhead. These cannons come in normal or heavy variants, the latter using stronger coils but requiring more power.
When mounted on planetary vehicles, the range of these weapons changes to extreme.

gear.name: Automatic Accelerator Cannon
description: Working on the same principle as any other mass accelerator weapons, but using far smaller projectiles and much higher fire-rates, these auto-cannons are designed for anti-fighter combat.
When mounted on planetary vehicles, the range of these weapons changes to long.

gear.name: Concussion Missile Launcher
description: Explosive missiles outfitted with precision guidance systems that home in on targets and detonate, using their conventional high-explosive warheads to cause concussive and thermal damage to all targets in their effective zone, while remaining far cheaper than the eezo-loaded {@gear Disruptor Torpedo Launcher|disruptor torpedoes}.
Concussion missiles can only be mounted on starships. Additional missiles cost 800 credits each.

gear.name: Disruptor Torpedo Launcher
description: A warhead loaded with element zero, which generates a random, fluctuating mass effect field on its impact point, ripping a target apart. These weapons are deployed from {@vehicle fighter|fighters} and light capital ships but are only effective at short ranges, and while they can easily pierce kinetic barriers, they are still interceptable by defensive systems such as {@gear GARDIAN Lasers|GARDIAN lasers}.
Disruptor torpedoes can only be mounted on starships. Additional torpedoes cost 2,000 credits each.

gear.name: Machine Gun
description: These anti-personnel weapons are essentially scaled up squad-support weaponry. While smaller than the previously mentioned auto-cannons, they still easily take out small targets and can even threaten light vehicles.
When mounted on planetary vehicles, the range of these weapons changes to long.

gear.name: Magnetic-Hydrodynamic Cannon
description: Developed from scavenged geth technology, these weapons fire a molten jet of iron-uranium-tungsten alloy, using a corridor of mass effect fields. With tremendous kinetic and thermal energy, these weapons essentially cut through enemy ships and heavy armor.
Magnetic-hydrodynamic cannons can only be mounted on starships.

gear.name: Unguided Rocket Launcher
description: These cheap and simple weapons fire a high-explosive warhead at a target. While not as powerful as {@gear Concussion Missile Launcher|concussion missiles} and not outfitted with guidance systems, these weapons can still make quick work of light vehicles and can decimate squads of infantry.
Unguided rocket launchers can only be mounted on planetary vehicles.

optionFeature.name: Heavy Construction
description: With melee weapons, increasing the weight greatly benefits their impact against a target. For ranged weapons, heavier materials allows the use of more powerful accelerators.
This making can only be applied to ranged weapons that fire projectiles or melee weapons.

{@b Ranged Weapon:} The weapon gains the {@quality Pierce|Pierce 2} quality or increases an existing {@quality Pierce} quality by 1. The weapon also gains the {@quality Cumbersome|Cumbersome 3} quality or increases an existing {@quality Cumbersome} quality by 1 and increases its encumbrance by 1.

{@b Melee Weapon:} Increase the weapon's damage by 1. The weapon gains the {@quality Cumbersome|Cumbersome 3} quality or increases an existing {@quality Cumbersome} quality by 1 and increases its encumbrance by 1.

{@b Rarity:} +1.

Note that any weapons listed in {@b Table 2-4: Unique Weapons} can not have any making applied to them, as they are unique.

optionFeature.name: High Output
description: Increasing the overall kinetic energy output on ranged weapons greatly increases their damage output, but at the cost of faster overheating.
This making can only be applied to ranged weapons that fire projectiles.

{@b Ranged Weapon:} Increase the weapon's damage by 2. If the weapon has the {@quality Blast} quality, it is increased by 2. The weapon gains the {@quality Limited Ammo|Limited Ammo 3} quality or reduces an existing {@quality Limited Ammo} quality by 2. The weapon may be reloaded with the {@gear spare thermal clip} item (see page 62).

optionFeature.name: Modular Construction
description: Designed with aftermarket modification in mind, weapons like these are built with full access to most of their internal components, and are outfitted with additional external mounting points.
{@b Ranged or Melee Weapon:} Increase the weapon's number of hard points by 2.

{@b Rarity:} No Change.

optionFeature.name: Outlaw
description: Created by independent gunsmiths or by mercenary companies themselves, these weapons are often cobbled together from stock pieces and their own constructions. They are less reliable and don't always follow safety guidelines, but they are also not limited by them.

{@b Ranged Weapon:} Increase the weapon's damage by 1. The weapon gains the {@quality Inferior} quality. Your GM may spend {@symbols hhh} or {@symbols d} from a combat check to damage the weapon by one step.

{@b Melee Weapon:} Decrease the weapon's Critical rating by 1. The weapon gains the {@quality Inferior} quality. Your GM may spend {@symbols hhh} or {@symbols d} from a combat check to damage the weapon by one step.

description: Firing superconductive projectiles, condensed plasma charges or projectiles with unique coating, these kinds of weapons tear apart shields and synthetic targets.
This making can only be applied to ranged weapons that fire projectiles.
{@b Ranged Weapon:} The weapon gains the {@quality Phasic|Phasic 2} quality or increases an existing {@quality Phasic} quality by 2.

description: Weapons of the highest quality, reserved to elite government military units such as the STG or Spectres. Making use of lightweight, experimental materials and precision engineering, these weapons are not found on the normal market.
{@b Ranged or Melee Weapon:} Increase the weapon's damage by 1. The weapon gains the {@quality Superior} quality. Reduce the weapon's encumbrance by 1.

adversary.name: Klixen
description: Insectoid creatures, resembling a cross between crabs and beetles that crawl the surface of desolate and poisonous worlds, having long since adapted to those environments. Their bodies contain glands that produce flammable liquids which they spit at targets.

adversary.name: Nathak
description: Large, wolf-like creatures that stalk the frozen wastes of Noveria. They hunt in packs, tearing apart prey with their strong teeth.

adversary.name: Pyjak
description: Pyjaks, sometimes referred to as "space monkeys", are a primitive species thriving on a variety of planets throughout the galaxy. Considered to be a nuisance by the krogan of Tuchanka, they are kept as pets by some wealthy citizens.

adversary.name: Thresher Maw
description: These giant, burrowing worm-like creatures live in solitude on various desolate planets and moons around the galaxy. Reproducing by spores that travel to other planets by adhering to spacecraft, they slowly grow into enormous creatures, impervious to nearly all environmental conditions, and somehow thriving on a diet of minerals and solar radiation. They are fiercely territorial and a threat even to armored vehicles.

adversary.name: Varren
description: The Varren are a species of omnivorous creatures originating from Tuchanka, though they have long since spread to a variety of worlds in the galaxy. Like most other lifeforms stemming from Tuchanka, they are savage, adaptable and highly resilient to adverse conditions. Varren hunt in packs, dominated by an alpha; except in ecosystems where they are outclassed as predators and instead live a life as scavengers.

abilities.name: Takedown
abilities.description: As an action make an opposed {@skill Brawl} vs {@skill Resilience} check targeting an engaged opponent; if successful, target is knocked {@rule prone} and {@rule immobilized} until the end of this character's next turn.

adversary.name: Varren Alpha
description: The strongest, most cunning and most ferocious in their respective pack, the alpha traditionally assumes its position by challenging and killing the previous packleader. Unlike various other predatory species, a Varren alpha does not hang back, but instead prefers to lead their pack into a hunt, taking point, and challenging the strongest prey to prove their worth.

abilities.name: Takedown
abilities.description: As an action make an opposed {@skill Brawl} vs {@skill Resilience} check targeting an engaged opponent; if successful, target is knocked {@rule prone} and {@rule immobilized} until the end of this character's next turn.

adversary.name: Varren Biotic
description: While a rare sight indeed, {@adversary Varren} have been known to acquire biotic abilities due to exposure to high eezo concentrations. Most commonly found on Thessia, due to the increased amount of element zero in its ecosystem, these biotic Varren are preferably used by their owners in pit fights and races, as their biotic condition makes them even more aggressive and short-tempered.

adversary.name: Assault Trooper
description: The standard soldiers and backbone of the {@rule Cerberus} military branch. Put through rigorous physical training and mental conditioning, they are fearless and lethal combatants, loyal to their ideals until death.

adversary.name: Centurion
description: Leading squads of troopers into the fight, {@rule Cerberus} centurions are front-line tacticians and fire support units. Unlike the troops that accompany them, they are outfitted with shields and carry heavier equipment, preferring to stay in the back of an encounter and support their troops with tactical measures like smoke grenades.
gear: {@gear Medium Armor} with {@gear enhanced optics}: 1 defense, +2 soak; remove {@dice setback|2} due to smoke or darkness.

adversary.name: Combat Engineer
description: The combat engineers serve as tactical support troops in the {@rule Cerberus} staff. They operate on the front lines and use their technical expertise to sabotage their enemies and set up defensive positions.

adversary.name: Dragoon
description: The dragoon is the end result of {@rule Cerberus}' Project Phoenix, an experimental series on biotic combat abilities and accompanying weaponry. Trained in the use of biotics in close-quarter situations, but also masters of their unique {@gear biotic lashes}, these soldiers rush the enemy and lay into them with intense physical attacks.
{@b Biotics:} Dragoons have access to all biotic abilities and may select any of their additional effects. The biotic powers they use most often are the following:

spells.name: Charge
spells.description: Choose one target at short or medium range and make an {@difficulty average|Biotics}; if successful, the target suffers 5 damage + 1 damage per uncanceled {@symbols s} and the dragoon moves into engaged range with the target.

spells.name: Slam
spells.description: Choose one target in engaged range and make an {@difficulty average|Biotics}; if successful, the target suffers 5 damage + 1 damage per uncanceled {@symbols s}, with the {@quality Blast|Blast 4} quality.

gear: {@gear Gemini Biotic Amp}: Add +2 damage to biotic attacks; adding Charge or Close Combat effects does not increase difficulty.
Dragoon Armor: +2 soak, may draw or holster {@gear biotic lashes} as an incidental.

adversary.name: Guardian
description: Commonly nicknamed "human tanks", the Guardian units advance slowly, using their tough riot shields to keep themselves protected from incoming fire. Should they get in range, their Talon pistols make quick and bloody work of any unshielded opponents.
{@i * This adversary's defense attribute includes the bonuses from their weapons.}

adversary.name: Nemesis
description: Agile sharpshooter units within {@rule Cerberus}' ranks, the Nemesis is equipped with very light gear, except for their quite heavy {@gear sniper rifle}. Outfitted with unique cybernetics that improve their combat performance, allow them to handle their heavy weapons, and disintegrate their bodies upon death, these units have created a feared reputation among their foes.

adversary.name: Phantom
description: Phantoms serve as highly lethal infiltration and assassination units within {@rule Cerberus}. Recruited from talented biotics and augmented with cybernetic enhancements, they are outfitted with stealth technology and given monomolecular swords that they use to cut and stab their way through slews of enemies.
{@i * This adversary's defense attribute includes the bonuses from their weapons.}
{@b Biotics:} {@rule Cerberus} phantoms can only use the biotic barrier power and only in the following way:

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: After performing a combat check, may spend {@symbols aa} or {@symbols t} to turn invisible, gaining {@rule Concealment (Darkness, Smoke, and Intervening Terrain)|concealment} worth 3 dice.

spells.name: Empowered Barrier
spells.description: Make an {@difficulty average|Biotics}; if successful, until the end of the phantom's next turn, reduce the damage of all hits against them by one for every {@symbols s}. The phantom can maintain these effects with the {@rule concentrate|concentrate maneuver}.

gear: Phantom Biotic Amp: Reduce the difficulty of biotic barrier checks by one.

adversary.name: Citadel Diplomat
description: With the Citadel having become the center of government for the majority of the galaxy, the majority of species have gained an embassy there and allocated their dignitaries. This profile should befit the majority of political contacts the PCs interact with.

adversary.name: Citadel Merchant
description: With the presidium and all wards of the Citadel featuring a large collection of commercial districts, this profile serves to represent the majority of legitimate business- and tradespeople.
gear: {@gear Mercantile Datapad}: Add {@dice boost} to all {@skill Negotiation} checks to buy or sell wares in Council Space.

adversary.name: Dockworker
description: While mechs, drones and other automated systems assist with a majority of mundane labor, there is still a large number of organic workforce, their jobs kept safe by a strong system of unions. This profile can serve to represent anyone working physically strenuous jobs.

adversary.name: Government Official
description: Bureaucrats are viewed by many people as a nuisance to any workflow and protocol heavy pencil pushers. They are however essential to keep any government running and their paperwork keeps the galaxy and inter-species relations running smoothly.

abilities.name: Red Tape
abilities.description: During social encounters, may spend {@symbols hhh} generated by an opponent to discover (or invent) a legal violation that requires a fine, fee, or additional authorization form that the opponent must complete before accomplishing their goals.

adversary.name: Asari Justicar
description: Sworn into the Code of Justice that dictates their actions for most every possible situation, the Asari Justicar act to right any wrongs in asari space. Forsworn from starting a family and having children, their only goal is to deliver justice, protect the innocent and punish the guilty.
{@b Biotics:} A justicar has access to all biotic abilities and may select any of their additional effects. The biotic powers they use most often are the following:

abilities.name: Natural
abilities.description: Once per session, may reroll any one {@skill Biotics} or {@skill Discipline} check.

spells.name: Reave
spells.description: Choose one organic target at short or medium range and make an {@difficulty average|Biotics}; if successful, the target takes 9 damage + 1 damage per uncancelled {@symbols s}, with a Critical Rating of 2 and the {@quality Vicious|Vicious 2} quality.

spells.name: Annihilation
spells.description: Choose one target at short or medium range and make an {@difficulty average|Biotics}; if successful, the target takes 9 damage + 1 damage per uncancelled {@symbols s}, with the {@quality Burn|Burn 3} quality.

spells.name: Lance
spells.description: Choose one target at short or medium range and make a {@difficulty hard|Biotics}; if successful, the target takes 14 damage + 1 damage per uncancelled {@symbols s}.

spells.name: Levitation
spells.description: Make a {@difficulty hard|Biotics}; if successful, until the end of the justicar's next turn, they increase the ability of any of their skill checks by one and gain the ability to levitate (see page 100 of the {@title Genesys} Core Rulebook). The justicar can maintain these effects with a {@rule concentrate|concentrate maneuver}.

spells.name: Biotic Sphere
spells.description: Make a {@difficulty hard|Biotics}; if successful, until the end of the justicar's next turn, two targets + an additional one per {@symbols a} reduce the damage of all hits they suffer by one + an additional one per {@symbols ss} beyond the first. The justicar can maintain these effects with a {@rule concentrate|concentrate maneuver}.

gear: {@gear Savant Biotic Amp}: Add +4 damage to biotic attacks; the first Range effect added does not increase difficulty.

adversary.name: C-Sec Officer
description: Selected from talented law enforcement officers of their respective homeworlds, {@rule C-Sec} serves as the primary security force on the Citadel. The majority of their corps is made up from turians, often pursuing these careers due to their sense of duty and dedication in public service, but other Citadel space species have been known to enter service. This profile can also serve to represent most other law enforcement officers on most other worlds.

abilities.name: Lawful Authority
abilities.description: Add {@symbols s} to the results of any social skill checks made when interacting with civilians on the Citadel.

weapons.name: 1 riotfoam grenade
weapons.details: Cannot crit.

adversary.name: C-Sec Detective
description: Serving as the main investigative force of {@rule C-Sec}, detectives investigate crime scenes, compile evidence, interview witnesses and suspects. This profile can also serve to represent most other investigators on most other civilized worlds.

abilities.name: Lawful Authority
abilities.description: Add {@symbols s} to the results of any social skill checks made when interacting with civilians on the Citadel.

gear: Omni-tool with {@gear Advanced Scanner}: Add {@symbols a} to any {@skill Perception} check to investigate.

adversary.name: STG Operative
description: The Special Tactics Group of the Salarian Union serves as their espionage, recon, assassination and intelligence force. Their tactical expertise, surgical precision and ruthless efficiency served as key inspirations for the later established Citadel Spectres. A STG operative is fully devoted to the mission assigned and will complete it at any cost, even if it results in civilian casualties.
{@b Tech:} STG operatives can have up to 3 tech abilities readied and may select any of their additional effects. The tech powers they use most often are the following:

spells.name: Incinerate
spells.description: Choose one target at short or medium range and make an {@difficulty average|Tech}; if successful, the target suffers 9 damage + 1 damage per uncanceled {@symbols s}, with the {@quality Burn|Burn 2} quality.

spells.name: Overload
spells.description: Choose one target at short or medium range and make an {@difficulty average|Tech}; if successful, the target suffers 9 damage + 1 damage per uncanceled {@symbols s}, with the {@quality Phasic|Phasic 1} quality.

spells.name: Tactical Cloak
spells.description: Make an {@difficulty average|Tech}; if successful, until the end of the operative's next turn, they are rendered invisible, disengage from all foes, are unable to be engaged and gain {@rule Concealment (Darkness, Smoke, and Intervening Terrain)|concealment} worth three dice. The operative can maintain these effects with the {@rule concentrate|concentrate maneuver}.

spells.name: Overheat
spells.description: Choose one target carrying a powered weapon in short or medium range and make an {@difficulty average|Tech}; if successful, the weapon immediately runs out of ammo.

gear: {@gear Logic Arrest Omni-tool}: Add +4 damage to tech attacks; the first Range effect added does not increase difficulty; when casting a tech attack power, may upgrade the difficulty of the check and add the {@quality Pierce|Pierce 2} quality to the check; when the character rolls {@symbols t} while casting a tech power, they roll {@dice boost} and add it to the results.

adversary.name: Turian Spectre
description: The Special Tactics and Reconnaissance (Spectres) act as the elite enforcing agents of the Citadel. They answer to none but the council and are set in their task to preserve stability in the galaxy by any means necessary. Originally recruited from STG and asari commandos, they have since gained multiple turian members, decorated military commanders in their own right. Their position above any laws, but the council's judgment, adds an air of fear and mistrust to the respect and order they convey.
gear: {@gear Medium Armor} with {@gear Improved Kinetic Barriers|Improved Barriers} and {@gear Jump Jets}: 2 defense, +2 soak; once per encounter may use an out-of-turn incidental to fly until the end of their next turn.

adversary.name: Asari Valkyrie
description: Specialist units of the Asari Republics, these warriors are not only gifted with strong biotic potential, but also equipped with powerful tech to further amplify their combat potential.
{@b Biotics:} Asari valkyries have access to all biotic abilities and may select any of their additional effects. The biotic powers they use most often are the following:
{@b Tech:} Asari valkyries can have up to 2 tech abilities readied and may select any of their additional effects. The tech powers they use most often are the following:

spells.name: Annihilation Field
spells.description: Choose one target at short or medium range and make a {@difficulty hard|Biotics}; if successful, the target takes 5 damage + 1 damage per uncancelled {@symbols s}, with the {@quality Blast|Blast 2} and {@quality Burn|Burn 2} qualities.

spells.name: Warp
spells.description: Choose one target at short or medium range and make a {@difficulty hard|Biotics}; if successful, the target suffers 5 damage + 1 damage per uncanceled {@symbols s}, with the {@quality Pierce|Pierce 2} and {@quality Sunder} quality.

spells.name: Neural Shock
spells.description: Make an {@difficulty average|Tech} targeting an opponent in short or medium range; if successful, the target suffers 7 damage + 1 damage per uncanceled {@symbols s}, with the {@quality Disorient|Disorient 1} quality.

spells.name: Tech Armor
spells.description: Make an {@difficulty average|Tech}; if successful, until the end of the valkyrie's next turn, reduce the damage of all hits against them by one, plus one for every {@symbols ss}. The valkyrie can maintain these effects with the {@rule concentrate|concentrate maneuver}.

gear: {@gear Logic Arrest Omni-tool}: Add +4 damage to tech attacks; the first Range effect added does not increase difficulty.

adversary.name: Elcor "Living Tank"
description: With their slow speed and immense size, elcor are unfortunately easy targets on the battlefields of the galaxy. Fortunately however, their thick hide allows them to ignore the majority of incoming small-arms fire. With their natural toughness and strength, they have long since moved to a form of combat that utilizes these benefits, mounting weaponry appropriate for light vehicles on their backs and leaving it to the VI control systems to aim and fire these. While effective, this practice has earned them the nickname "living tanks", among other less flattering names.

abilities.name: Big Guns
abilities.description: This character has an encumbrance capacity of 14.

weapons.name: Armor-mounted light accelerator cannon with VI fire assist
weapons.details: {@quality Breach|Breach 1}, {@quality Cumbersome|Cumbersome 5}, {@quality Slow-Firing|Slow-Firing 1}. Add {@dice boost} to any checks made with this weapon. If this weapon has not been used, may spend {@symbols aaa} or {@symbols t} from any skill check to cause an automatic hit against a target in range.

adversary.name: Enlisted Soldier
description: Making up the majority of all species' militaries, these troopers are motivated by honor and duty to protect the values of their people, if need be by force. This profile covers light infantry and more commonly the marines serving upon the countless military vessels that move throughout the galaxy.

adversary.name: Fighter Pilot
description: These pilots are trained in the operation of fighters, interceptors and gunships, to engage in fast and dangerous dogfights and engage enemy capital ships at close range. Requiring excellent reflexes and in one of the most vulnerable positions during an engagement, many of these pilots turn out to be true adrenaline junkies.

adversary.name: Military Officer
description: Taking commands of squads, platoons, companies and all larger military units, these officers are trained to be tactical and adapt their strategies quickly in the field. Good soldiers in their own right, their true strength lies in the loyalty and courage they inspire in their fellow troops.

adversary.name: Navy Crewman
description: Assigned to the various stations on larger battleships, as well as on installations and docks, these soldiers form the bulk of their crew. With jobs ranging from sensor operation, over flight control and engineering to weapon systems, they are trained to operate as a large team to keep their vessels running.

adversary.name: N7 Destroyer
description: As part of the few elite soldiers to achieve the prestigious N7 rank of the {@rule Systems Alliance|Alliance}, the Destroyer units are outfitted with {@gear heavy armor} that features strength assistance and inbuilt weapon systems. Originally an experimental project, they saw deployment part way through the Reaper War, driving back foes from strategic positions.

weapons.name: Armor-mounted micro-missile launcher
weapons.details: Add {@dice boost} to any checks made with this weapon. If this weapon has not been used, may spend {@symbols aaa} or {@symbols t} from any skill check to cause an automatic hit against a target in range.

gear: T5-V Battlesuit: 2 defense, +2 soak; using the {@quality Auto-fire} quality does not increase the difficulty of combat checks, but each time the character triggers an additional hit, they suffer 1 strain; adds {@symbols s} to any {@characteristic Brawn}-based checks (with the exception of {@skill Resilience}).

adversary.name: N7 Paladin
description: These {@rule Systems Alliance} soldiers, who have earned the honor to wear the N7 rank insignia on their armor, are trained in asymmetric warfare and strategic positioning. With a knack for tech powers, and carrying an {@gear omni-shield} to block enemy fire, they saw increased deployment throughout the late part of the Reaper War, defending vital compounds from the attacking forces.
{@i * This adversary's defense attribute includes the bonuses from their weapons.}
{@b Tech:} An N7 paladin can have up to 3 tech abilities readied and may select any of their additional effects. The tech powers they use most often are the following:

spells.name: Incinerate
spells.description: Choose one target at short or medium range and make an {@difficulty average|Tech}; if successful, the target suffers 7 damage + 1 damage per uncanceled {@symbols s}, with the {@quality Burn|Burn 3} quality.

spells.name: Cryo Blast
spells.description: Choose one target at short or medium range and make an {@difficulty average|Tech}; if successful, the target suffers 7 damage + 1 damage per uncanceled {@symbols s}, with the {@quality Ensnare|Ensnare 3} quality.

spells.name: Charged Melee
spells.description: Make an {@difficulty average|Tech}; if successful, until the end of the paladin's next turn, their {@skill Brawl} and {@skill Melee} weapon attacks gain the {@quality Stun|Stun 3} and {@quality Phasic|Phasic 3} qualities. The Paladin can maintain these effects with the {@rule concentrate|concentrate maneuver}.

spells.name: Energy Drain
spells.description: Make an {@difficulty average|Tech} targeting an opponent in short or medium range; if successful, until the end of the paladin's next turn, the target decreases their melee and ranged defense by up to 3 and the paladin increases their defense by an equal amount.
